name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

oneOf.title: Standard
oneOf.description: A box with a top, shelves, doors or drawers.

oneOf.title: Sink base
oneOf.description: Two rails instead of a top, so the sink and its pipes fit. No shelves, doors only.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes in this dialog. The numbers shown at first are mm.

width.title: Width
width.description: Outside width of the cabinet, side to side.

height.title: Height
height.description: Outside height, from the floor to the top, plinth included.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Outside depth, front to back, back board included.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the boards the cabinet is made of: sides, top, bottom, shelves. 18 mm is usual.

back.title: Back
back.description: The thin board that closes the cabinet at the back.

oneOf.title: In a groove
oneOf.description: Slid into a slot cut in the sides, top and bottom, 12 mm from the rear.

oneOf.title: Overlaid
oneOf.description: Nailed or screwed onto the rear edges.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No back: open behind.

back_thickness.title: Back thickness
back_thickness.description: Thickness of the back board, usually thinner than the rest, such as 6 mm.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Upright boards inside that split the cabinet into equal compartments side by side.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Number of equal drawers, filling the front, with no shelves. Not with doors or dividers.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The plinth is the board at floor level under the doors, set 50 mm back for your toes. 0 for none.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes inside the sides, 32 mm apart, for pins the shelves rest on. You can move the shelves later.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Number of doors: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment. Each gets holes for 35 mm cup hinges.

door_hinge.title: First door hinged
door_hinge.description: The side the first door hangs on. The next doors alternate; two always open from the middle.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: How the doors and drawer fronts sit on the cabinet.

oneOf.title: Overlay
oneOf.description: In front of the cabinet, covering the board edges. The usual kitchen look.

oneOf.title: Inset
oneOf.description: Inside the opening, flush with the cabinet's front edges.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around and between the doors and drawer fronts, so they open without rubbing. 0.5 to 6 mm.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw handles on: in the doors, on the side that opens, and in the drawer fronts.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart, for a bar handle.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go. On a drawer front Auto is the middle.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit, middle on a door over 1200 mm.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the top.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the bottom.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's name on it, the name the cut list uses, so you can tell the parts apart.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick a board of the cabinet to place this one against or to match. Empty: none.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Take the height, depth, panel thickness and plinth from the selected cabinet, and keep them linked.

oneOf.title: Selected cabinet
oneOf.description: Resize that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: What every board is made of. Change single parts later with Material.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No material set.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where the new cabinet goes. All but the origin put it against the selected cabinet.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Against the selected side or top; else at the origin.

oneOf.title: At the origin
oneOf.description: At the centre of the design.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Against its right side, backs flush; turned to continue a corner cabinet's return.

oneOf.title: Left of selected
oneOf.description: Against its left side, backs flush.

oneOf.title: Above selected
oneOf.description: On top of it, backs flush.

name.title: Name
name.description: The cabinet's name; each board is named after it, such as Cabinet Side L. A taken name gets the next free number.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes in this dialog. The numbers shown at first are mm.

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the room the cabinet fits in.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Right when placed right of the selected cabinet, else left.

oneOf.title: Left
oneOf.description: Corner at the back left; the return runs forward along the left wall.

oneOf.title: Right
oneOf.description: The mirror image.
Two fronts at a right angle, with a pair of doors that fold together.

oneOf.title: Diagonal
oneOf.description: One front across the corner at 45 degrees, with one door.

width.title: Width
width.description: Length along the back wall, from the corner.

return.title: Return
return.description: Length along the side wall, from the corner: the arm that turns the corner.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How deep both arms are, wall to front. Diagonal: at the end of the width; at the return's end it is width - return + depth.

height.title: Height
height.description: Outside height, from the floor to the top, plinth included.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the boards the cabinet is made of. 18 mm is usual.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The plinth is the board at floor level under the doors, set 50 mm back for your toes. 0 for none.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes in the ends and backs, 32 mm apart, for pins the shelves rest on.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Doors with holes for 35 mm cup hinges, in front of the cabinet. L-shaped: a pair that folds together. Diagonal: one door.

oneOf.title: Hinged left
oneOf.description: Hinged at the cabinet's left end, as you face the corner.

oneOf.title: Hinged right
oneOf.description: Hinged at its right end.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around the doors, so they open without rubbing. 0.5 to 6 mm.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw a handle on. L-shaped: in the door that folds, at its free end. Diagonal: at the opening edge.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart, for a bar handle.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit, middle on a door over 1200 mm.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the top.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the bottom.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's name on it, the name the cut list uses, so you can tell the parts apart.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick a board of the cabinet to place this one against or to match. Empty: none.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Take the height, depth, panel thickness and plinth from the selected cabinet, and keep them linked.

oneOf.title: Selected cabinet
oneOf.description: Resize that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: What every board is made of. Change single parts later with Material.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No material set.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where the new cabinet goes. All but the origin put it against the selected cabinet.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Against the selected side or top; else at the origin.

oneOf.title: At the origin
oneOf.description: At the centre of the design.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Against its right side, backs flush; turned to continue a corner cabinet's return.

oneOf.title: Left of selected
oneOf.description: Against its left side, backs flush.

oneOf.title: Above selected
oneOf.description: On top of it, backs flush.

name.title: Name
name.description: The cabinet's name; each board is named after it, such as Corner Side L. A taken name gets the next free number.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to change. Keep leaves a choice as it is.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Box cabinet only: a standard cabinet or a sink base, with rails instead of a top.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment. Empty: as it is.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Upright boards that split the inside into compartments. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Number of doors. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Number of drawers. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around the doors and drawer fronts. Empty: as it is.

door_hinge.title: First door hinged
door_hinge.description: The side the first door hangs on. Box cabinet only.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: Overlay: in front of the cabinet. Inset: inside the opening. Box cabinet only.

corner_doors.title: Corner doors
corner_doors.description: Which end the doors hang on. Corner cabinet only.

shape.title: Corner shape
shape.description: The shape of the front. Corner cabinet only.

back.title: Back
back.description: The thin board at the back. Box cabinet only.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes for pins the shelves rest on.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw handles on, in doors and drawer fronts.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle goes.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Each board's name written on it.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The board at floor level under the doors. In the cabinet's unit; 0 for none. Empty: as it is.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to drill.

type.title: Type
type.description: How the sides are fixed to the bottom and top: holes are drilled where they meet.

oneOf.title: Confirmat screws
oneOf.description: Thick 7 x 50 mm furniture screws: a 7 mm hole through the side and a 5 mm pilot hole.

oneOf.title: Dowels
oneOf.description: 8 mm holes for 8 x 35 mm wooden pegs glued into both boards.

selection.title: Selected
selection.description: Pick a board of the cabinet, or the parts to change.

material.title: Material
material.description: What the boards are made of. The cut list groups parts by it.

oneOf.title: Whole cabinet
oneOf.description: Every board of the cabinet you picked a part of.

oneOf.title: Selected parts
oneOf.description: Only the picked parts, such as the doors.

banding.title: Edge banding
banding.description: A thin strip glued onto visible board edges to cover them. Doors and drawer fronts get it all round, other boards at the front.

size.title: Sizes
size.description: Which size the list gives for a banded part.

oneOf.title: Finished
oneOf.description: As in the model, banding included.

oneOf.title: Cut
oneOf.description: The size to saw: less the banding on each banded edge.

sheet.title: Sheet size
sheet.description: Size of the boards you buy, length x width in mm. The cutting layouts fit the parts onto these.

kerf.title: Saw kerf (mm)
kerf.description: Width of the saw blade: the wood lost to each cut, left between parts on the sheet.

trim.title: Edge trim (mm)
trim.description: Cut off each edge of the sheet first, as factory edges are often chipped or not square.

diagrams.title: Cutting diagrams
diagrams.description: A drawing of each sheet in the PDF, showing where each part is cut from.

format.title: Format
format.description: The kind of file Save as writes.

oneOf.title: PDF
oneOf.description: A cut list to print.

oneOf.title: CSV
oneOf.description: A table for a spreadsheet.

oneOf.title: Labels (PDF)
oneOf.description: A sticker per board, 24 on an A4 sheet.

oneOf.title: DXF
oneOf.description: One drawing per sheet: parts, names and holes, for a CNC.

file.title: Save as
file.description: File name, saved in the folder approved at install. Empty: no file, the list only shows in the result.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to draw.

scope.title: Draw
scope.description: A workshop sheet per cabinet in the drawing Woodwork: front, side and 3D views, sizes and its boards.
